# `mcp-scaffold add-mcp-app`

- **Usage**: `mcp-scaffold add-mcp-app [FLAGS] <name>`

Add a second MCP app to apps/<name>-mcp/ inside an existing scaffolded repo

## Arguments

### `<name>`

Bare tool name for the new app (no -mcp suffix)

## Flags

### `--target <dir>`

Path to the scaffolded repo

### `--scope <scope>`

Npm scope, with leading @. Auto-detected from existing apps/*-mcp/ if omitted.

### `--no-tui`

Skip the Ink/React TUI surface for the new app

### `--no-http`

Skip the Streamable HTTP transport for the new app

### `--no-rust-accel`

Skip the rust-accel workspace dep for the new app
